name: climate_response
description: Controlled synthetic thermal response with annual forcing and fresh zero-anomaly preparations.
public_contract: Only describe() and budgeted noisy observations are candidate-facing; generator, strata, seeds, source, panels and raw development diagnostics remain operator-only.
initial_state: Every internal temperature anomaly is assigned zero; no time-zero row is returned.
version_policy: New experimental package; historical cohorts remain unchanged. Actual integration, live evaluation and scientific conclusions require separate frozen evidence.
